A '''day spa''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The combat [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], better known as Doc, knew of the [[Spa/Legends|spa]] from his time on Ord Mantell, but several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later he was uncertain as to whether the spa had been destroyed in the ongoing [[Separatist War]] between the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|Ord Mantell government]] and the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]].<ref name="Date night" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|There's also a great day spa on Ord Mantell, assuming it didn't get blown up during the Separatist War.|Doc|<ref name="Date night" />}}
The spa was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], within the message "Date night" from the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class's companion character Doc. The message will only be sent to [[Gender/Legends|female]] players who are pursuing a romance with Doc.<ref name="Date night" />
